scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: cd apps/api && bun run typecheck && cd ../web && bun run typecheck
scripts.lint: cd apps/api && bun run lint && cd ../web && bun run lint
scripts.test: cd apps/api && bun run test && cd ../web && bun run test
scripts.install:all: cd apps/api && bun install && cd ../web && bun install && cd ../e2e && bun install && cd ../docs && bun install
